## R0017 corrective qualification — issue 23 remains OPEN

Related to #23 and merged PR #70. This is a non-closing review PR for the qualification tools used to investigate the challenged whole-contract closure. The earlier certificate [6703510170](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/23#issuecomment-6703510170) has been withdrawn at its original location; the [corrective ledger](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/23#issuecomment-6713121284) records the current limits.

PR70 changed the browser wrapper and shared script-admission dependency. The earlier Windows evidence did not automatically qualify those changed consumers. The original Linux healthy attempt also retained a real 29/30 INCOMPLETE observation with insufficient readiness telemetry to reconstruct its exact cause. This work collects actual Windows Chromium/Firefox evidence and preserves failures and unexecuted observations.

The branch adds a finite native Windows collector, owned driver/profile cleanup, source and public-payload admission, and raw protocol traces. The second phase exercises the affected motion-preference, transport, fixture identity, tomorrow-data and public-wrapper consumers. The first phase is now manual-only so publishing the second phase does not replay its earlier 12 sessions.

The application payload remains merge `eebba178172f96b3ffe5ab3845bc0fffd57c6e1b`, tree `6b94a3933f9d1381b1c2ceaab287c93afb215ecb`. Only seven qualification/workflow/documentation files differ from main. Product source, generated runtime, frozen V1 and all product expectations remain unchanged.

The collector retains the original 4 s / 8 s / 3 s application deadlines, exact 30-case/141-assertion healthy population, composed-calendar readiness requirement, strict interception-error gate, all planned/unstarted rows and verified owned cleanup. Expected negative controls remain actual FAIL/INCOMPLETE observations; their expected-outcome oracle is separate. The collector always labels its overall qualification PARTIAL. A successful workflow is not whole-RLGWO acceptance.
